project: Project Rahul — Family 2D Pixel-Art Fighting Game

global_specs.airborne_playback_convention: play_once_hold_last_frame_until_landing (game engine controls vertical jump arc)

animations.gameplay_purpose: Default neutral standing combat state; communicates Rahul's heavy muscular presence and readiness without excessive bounce.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Stable wide standing fighting guard, knees slightly bent, lead left hand forward at chin/chest height, rear right hand guarding chest.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F8: Smoothly returns to F1 neutral fighting guard posture for seamless looping.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Connects directly to Forward Walk F1, Backward Walk F1, Forward Dash F1, Backward Dash F1, Crouch Transition F1, and Jump Take-Off F1; receives Return to Standing F2 and Landing F2.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled forward combat advance toward the opponent with weighted muscular stride and natural arm counterbalance.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Balanced standing guard matching Idle F1 before initiating lead-foot advance.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F6: Settled forward stance ready to cycle seamlessly back into F1 or exit cleanly into Idle F1.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Enters smoothly from Idle F1; returns cleanly to Idle F1 on directional input release.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Defensive retreat while maintaining forward-facing guard toward the opponent (never turns away).
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Standard defensive fighting guard facing RIGHT.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F6: Compact retreating defensive guard facing RIGHT for seamless loop or return to Idle.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Maintains identical RIGHT-facing guard silhouette with Idle F1 and standing block states.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Rapid burst gap-closer driven by explosive rear-leg push-off, low athletic sprint lean, and planted braking recovery.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Coiled low anticipation crouch ready to explode forward.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F6: Stabilized upright standing fighting guard after F5 hard braking lunge.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Enters from Idle F1 or Forward Walk; F6 recovery connects directly to Idle F1 or standing attack startups.

pivot_and_ground_anchor.notes: F3 features a brief 22 px airborne back-hop clearance while remaining facing RIGHT.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Quick defensive evasive backstep to escape close pressure while keeping eyes and guard on the opponent.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Ready standing fighting guard facing RIGHT.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F5: Stabilized defensive fighting guard facing RIGHT after F4 bent-knee landing.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Enters from Idle F1; F5 connects directly back to Idle F1 or Backward Walk F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Fast grounded transition from standing guard into low crouching guard with natural muscular thigh compression.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Standing fighting guard matching Idle F1.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F2: Deep low crouching fighting guard (~189 px height), both feet planted on Y=272.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: F1 matches Idle F1; F2 matches Crouch Idle F1 in height, foot stance, and arm guard.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Held low defensive posture with subtle muscular chest/shoulder breathing and stable low center of gravity.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Low crouching defensive guard matching Crouch Transition F2.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F4: Settles back into initial low crouch guard for seamless looping.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Receives Crouch Transition F2; feeds directly into Return to Standing F1 and future Batch 2 crouching attacks.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Crisp grounded recovery from crouching stance back to upright fighting guard upon releasing Down.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Deep crouching fighting guard matching Crouch Idle F1.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F2: Full standing fighting guard matching Idle F1.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: F1 connects from Crouch Idle; F2 transitions seamlessly into Idle F1.

pivot_and_ground_anchor.notes: F1 grounded coiled anticipation at Y=272; F2 upward push-off with both feet 18 px clear of ground.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Pre-jump knee compression and explosive upward vertical launch into aerial state.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Deep coiled knee-bent jump preparation, arms swung back, both feet planted on Y=272.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F2: Full-body upward extension with arms driving upward and both feet visibly airborne.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: F1 enters from standing/walking states; F2 connects directly into Jump Airborne F1.

pivot_and_ground_anchor.notes: All 4 frames visibly airborne (24–52 px above Y=272); engine controls vertical jump arc.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Full aerial arc visual progression (rising -> compact mid-air tuck -> apex -> beginning of descent) synced with engine jump physics.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Rising airborne posture with lead knee driven high and trailing foot angled downward off the ground.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F4: Beginning of descent with legs opening downward and both feet still angled airborne, ready to hold until ground contact.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: F1 follows Jump Take-Off F2; F4 connects smoothly into Landing F1 upon ground collision.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Ground-impact shock absorption and recovery from aerial state back into neutral combat readiness.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Both feet planted on Y=272 with bent knees/hips absorbing landing weight and muscular arms lowered for balance.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F2: Upright stabilized standing fighting guard matching Idle F1.
animations.transition_compatibility_notes: Triggered immediately on ground contact from Jump Airborne F4; F2 transitions seamlessly into Idle F1.
